description: When a run is paused at an external seat: the exact system and user prompt that stage needs answered. A long prompt can be read in pages: pass max_chars (500 or more) and part (from 1); the answer says part, parts and total_chars. A run can wait on several stages at once (e.g. a panel of external critics): `waiting` lists them all; pass stage to get another one's prompt. Answer each with submit_stage; the run resumes once none is left.

max_chars.description: read a long prompt in pages of at most this many characters (500 or more); the answer says part, parts and total_chars. Leave out for the whole prompt

part.description: which page to return, counting from 1; needs max_chars

stage.description: which waiting stage to return; defaults to the first in `waiting`

name: external_prompt
